title: Vikram and Betal: The Kind King

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a kind king.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a king who cared for his people.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The king places a stone on the road.
scenes.text: The king placed a stone to test his people.
scenes.image_prompt: large stone blocking road with people walking around cartoon

scenes.text: Many people saw the stone but did nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: people walking around stone ignoring it cartoon

scenes.text: A farmer pushed the stone away to help others.
scenes.image_prompt: farmer pushing stone away with effort cartoon

scenes.text: The farmer found gold and was rewarded. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: farmer finding gold under stone while smiling cartoon

story: A kind king tested his people by placing a stone on the road. Only a farmer removed it to help others and was rewarded. Vikram said kindness brings rewards.
